tagline: Leading provider of data storage solutions for cloud and enterprise markets
hero_kpi_rationale: 39% year-over-year growth, driven by increased demand from cloud customers for high-capacity nearline drives and favorable pricing actions.
company_description: Seagate Technology Holdings plc engages in the provision of data storage technology and infrastructure solutions in Singapore, the United States, the Netherlands, and internationally. The company offers mass capacity storage products, including enterprise nearline hard disk drives (HDDs), enterprise nearline solid state drives (SSDs), enterprise nearline systems, video and image HDDs, and network-attached storage drives. It also offers legacy applications comprising Mission Critical HDDs and SSDs; external storage solutions under the Seagate Ultra Touch, One Touch, Expansion, and Basics product lines, as well as under the LaCie brand name; desktop drives for personal computers and workstation applications; notebook drives traditional notebooks, convertible systems, and external storage applications, DVR HDDs for video streaming applications, and gaming SSDs for gaming rigs. In addition, the company provides Lyve edge-to-cloud mass capacity platform, that includes modular hardware and software to support enterprises' on-premise and cloud storage infrastructure needs. risks.title: High Debt Levels
risks.summary: The company carries significant debt that could limit its ability to invest and withstand future economic shocks.
risks.score_rationale: Long-term debt stands at $4.995 billion with estimated annual interest payments of $321 million, impacting financial flexibility. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Component Supplier Dependency
risks.summary: The company is heavily dependent on suppliers for critical components. Supply chain disruptions could impact production and delivery timelines.
risks.score_rationale: Unconditional purchase obligations total $1.3 billion with suppliers, with $1.2 billion due within 12 months. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Currency Risks
risks.summary: Exchange rate fluctuations could impact operating margins and consolidated financial results, particularly given the current geographic concentration (Asia-Pacific 41%, Americas 49%).
risks.score_rationale: The company operates internationally with revenues generated in multiple currencies, exposing consolidated results to exchange rate fluctuations. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: International Tax Risks
risks.summary: Changes in international tax legislation, particularly in the United States, could alter the effective tax burden. The company must assess the impact of OBBBA in FY2026 and beyond.
risks.score_rationale: The company is domiciled in Singapore with operations in multiple tax jurisdictions. The 10-K mentions the potential impact of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) starting in FY2026. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Credit and Investment Risks
risks.summary: Credit risk exposure remains moderate. Investment losses recorded could continue amid market volatility.
risks.score_rationale: The company acknowledges credit risk exposure through its financial instruments and investments, with investment losses of $53 million in FY2025. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation and Legal Contingencies
risks.summary: The company is subject to risks related to ordinary legal contingencies associated with its international operations, with no indication of major litigation currently pending.
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K mentions legal commitments and contingencies without specific detail on material litigation. No significant provision amount is evident. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Macroeconomic and Geopolitical Environment
risks.summary: The company operates in a context of heightened geopolitical tensions and rapid trade policy changes that could impact sourcing, distribution, and regulations.
risks.score_rationale: The MD&A explicitly mentions a dynamic macroeconomic environment with rapid changes in trade policies and increasing geopolitical tensions. (default score, to be refined)

ai_positioning.summary: Seagate recognizes the long-term potential of generative AI applications to drive data storage demand, although this dimension is not yet a key driver of current results.
evidence: Over the long-term we expect our hard drive storage business to benefit from future growth in data demand and data value, including from the adoption of Generative AI applications.
